findings.highlight: Her master’s life has been ended by his own protector’s action
findings.evidenceJa: 守ろうとした彼女自身の手で、その命を終えていた
findings.governingReading: The boy who had been her Master had his life ended by her own hand—the very woman he tried to protect.
findings.explanation: The reciprocal protection relation and Saber’s direct agency are abstracted into a protector’s action.

findings.highlight: there was still enough time for her to be driven by evil
findings.evidenceJa: 魔が入り込む隙があった
findings.governingReading: There was an opening through which evil could enter.
findings.explanation: An opportunity in her exhausted mind becomes elapsed time and asserts that evil drove her.

findings.highlight: Her strained mind crumbled with that small weakness
findings.evidenceJa: 長く、長く疲労し磨り減っていた彼女の心は、爪の先ほどの弱さに負けてしまった
findings.governingReading: Her heart, long—long—exhausted and worn away, succumbed to a weakness no larger than a fingernail tip.
findings.explanation: Duration, erosion, and the precise minute image are flattened.

findings.highlight: She reaches out to her master whose breathing has ceased. small master.
findings.evidenceJa: 息絶えた主に手を伸ばす
findings.governingReading: She reaches toward her Master, whose breath has stopped.
findings.explanation: Stray “small master” revision debris interrupts the death scene.

findings.highlight: There is nothing sublime in her figure, lifting his remains. the neck of the boy.
findings.evidenceJa: その亡骸を抱き上げる少女に、かつての気高さは何処にもない
findings.governingReading: Nothing of her former nobility remains in the girl as she lifts his body into her arms.
findings.explanation: The English weakens her lost nobility and appends unsupported revision debris about the boy’s neck.

findings.evidenceJa: 彼岸からの招きに応じるように
findings.governingReading: As though answering an invitation from the far shore of death.
findings.explanation: The deathward metaphor is replaced by an unsupported male caller.
